clue.text: No amateur ran without a check-it's not allowed

parts.note: someone who is no amateur is a professional, a pro

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one piece sits around the other

parts.note: hied is an old word meaning hurried or ran
a bit is the mouthpiece used to check a horse

explanation.surface: A professional runner was halted mid-stride and told that move is banned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking; 'it's' is a link before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something forbidden by a rule or law is banned, the plain synonym.

clue.text: Swimmers turning in an easy arc

indicators.note: turning tells us the run of letters is read in the opposite direction
in tells us the letters sit inside the words easy arc

explanation.surface: Fish turning gently in a smooth curve.
explanation.walkthrough: SYAR is tucked inside 'easy arc'; 'turning' sends it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Rays are flat fish, so they are creatures that swim.

clue.text: Fair game with an all-round winner

definitions.text: Fair game with an all-round winner

parts.words: Fair game with an all-round winner
parts.note: a fairground stall where you win a prize by tossing a ring so that it lands all round it

explanation.surface: A funfair game whose champion is good at everything.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all-round winner' suggests a versatile champion, but it is the prize your ring falls around.
explanation.definitionFit: This ring-tossing stall is a classic fairground attraction where the encircled prize is won.

clue.text: The dotty type!

parts.note: reads as a crazy person, but means a kind of type made of raised dots

explanation.surface: A remark about an eccentric person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'type' is printing type and 'dotty' is literal: raised dots read by touch.
explanation.definitionFit: This tactile script for blind readers is formed from patterns of raised dots.

clue.text: Prune spruce

definitions.meaning: to prune is to cut back

explanation.surface: Advice to cut back a conifer.
explanation.definitionFit: Clipping a hedge is cutting it back, and a smart, tidy look is neat as well.

clue.text: Change claimed by ten

indicators.note: change tells us the letters of the next word are rearranged

explanation.surface: Coins someone says they got from a ten-pound note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Change' looks like money, which suits the answer, but it signals rearranging CLAIMED.
explanation.definitionFit: A base-ten number system counts in tens, so it works by tens.

clue.text: Undertaking to go in force

parts.note: to enter is to go in
to prise something is to force it open

explanation.surface: A venture that means storming in by force.
explanation.definitionFit: A bold project or venture is an undertaking.

clue.text: Many a man holding on can appear uncertain

indicators.note: holding puts the following letters inside the outer piece

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, i.e. many
a gent is a gentleman, a man
taken as written
a tin is a can

explanation.surface: Lots of men clinging on may look unsure of themselves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Many' gives C because the Roman numeral for a hundred stands for a large number; 'appear' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Contingent means dependent on chance, hence not certain.

clue.text: A French party which has to be open

parts.note: un is French for a
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A French celebration that has to be held openly.
explanation.definitionFit: To unfasten a knot or button is to open it.

clue.text: He's fired with enthusiasm in quite the wrong way

definitions.text: He's fired with enthusiasm in quite the wrong way

parts.words: He's fired with enthusiasm in quite the wrong way
parts.note: someone fired up, but whose enthusiasm is for setting fires

explanation.surface: Describes a zealot whose passion is misplaced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fired with enthusiasm' is literal: this person is enthusiastic about fire.
explanation.definitionFit: An arsonist driven by a compulsion to start blazes is fired with the wrong kind of enthusiasm.

clue.text: Turn up in green

parts.note: vert is the heraldic word for green

explanation.surface: Arrive wearing green.
explanation.walkthrough: VERT is green in heraldry, from French.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn something upside down is to upend it.

clue.text: Hit back with clever story

indicators.note: back tells us this word is read in reverse

parts.note: to rap is to hit
able means skilled or clever

explanation.surface: Responding with a smart tale.
explanation.definitionFit: A parable is a short moral tale, such as those in the Gospels.

clue.text: The person looking for gold, seeing spoor, crept off

indicators.note: off tells us the letters are rearranged, gone off from their order

explanation.surface: A gold hunter who notices animal tracks and sneaks away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' shuffles SPOOR and CREPT; 'seeing' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A miner searching for deposits of ore is the classic figure of the gold rush.

clue.text: A crook at ninety

parts.note: reads as an elderly villain, but a crook is a bend, here one of ninety degrees

explanation.surface: An aged criminal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crook' is a bend, and 'ninety' is degrees, not age.
explanation.definitionFit: A bend of exactly ninety degrees is the corner of a square.

clue.text: Enthusiastic always about, silver

indicators.note: about means going around the next piece

parts.note: e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, always
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Someone always keen on silver.
explanation.definitionFit: Keen and impatient for something describes an enthusiast.

clue.text: Capital security device for women!

parts.note: capital is the head, so a device securing what grows on women's heads

explanation.surface: An excellent safety gadget for women.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' seems to mean excellent, or a city, but refers to the head.
explanation.definitionFit: This U-shaped clip holds a woman's tresses in place on her head.

clue.text: The fellow having a way with him gets listened to

parts.note: he refers to a male, the fellow
Rd is short for road, a way

explanation.surface: A man with a manner about him is paid attention.
explanation.definitionFit: Something listened to has been caught by the ear.

clue.text: A supporter wants to relax by fifty

parts.note: to ease is to relax
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A fan who wants to unwind beside fifty others.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist's stand holds up a canvas, so it supports it.

clue.text: A wild revel's gory outcome

indicators.note: outcome hints that the letters of the word come out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A drunken party ends bloodily.
explanation.definitionFit: A riotous party with unrestrained indulgence is a debauch.

clue.text: Similar to relish

explanation.surface: Comparable to a pickle.
explanation.definitionFit: Resembling something, and enjoying something, are two senses of the same verb and preposition.

clue.text: Perspicacious viewers?

parts.note: people with sharp insight, literally those who see

explanation.surface: Sharp-eyed members of an audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'viewers' suggests TV audiences but means those who see the future.
explanation.definitionFit: Prophets were called this because they saw what others could not.

clue.text: A politician can take no rest-a new order

indicators.note: a new order means the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A lawmaker allowed no break by a new decree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new order' rearranges NORESTA; 'can take' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of an upper legislative house such as the US Senate is a politician.

clue.text: Tree requiring some maintenance work

definitions.meaning: the sorb or wild ... tree, a European tree
a check-up and repair on a car or machine

explanation.surface: A tree surgeon's routine job.
explanation.definitionFit: The sorb is called by this name, and a car's routine check-up is also so called.

clue.text: An American sportsman gets by swallowing a certain irritation

indicators.note: swallowing means one piece takes another inside it

parts.note: per means by, as in per post
an itch is a particular irritation of the skin

explanation.surface: A US athlete gets annoyed.
explanation.walkthrough: In baseball the player who throws to the batter has this name.
explanation.definitionFit: The baseball player who throws the ball to the batter is a sportsman found in America.

clue.text: At bottom find running water a nuisance

parts.note: the Dee is a river, running water
a pest is a nuisance

explanation.surface: Finding a stream annoying at the bottom of a valley.
explanation.walkthrough: The Dee is a river in Scotland and in Wales; 'find' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: One's innermost feelings lie lowest down, in the sense of fundamental.

clue.text: Numbers entering gasp, though far from stiff

indicators.note: entering means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to pant is to gasp
LI is fifty-one in Roman numerals, a pair of numbers

explanation.surface: Breathless figures, but not at all rigid.
explanation.definitionFit: Supple and flexible things bend easily, the opposite of rigid.

clue.text: A mince pie provides entertainment for some

indicators.note: pie is printers' slang for jumbled type, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A festive mince pie keeps a few people amused.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pie' is the indicator: printer's pie is type all jumbled.
explanation.definitionFit: Going to the pictures is a popular pastime, the films being entertainment.

clue.text: Members, having a right, writing

parts.note: MS is short for manuscript, a piece of writing

explanation.surface: Club members who have a right to put pen to paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Limbs are members of the body.

clue.text: A man from over the sea landed illegally

indicators.note: from tells us the letters are taken out of the words that follow

explanation.surface: An immigrant who came ashore unlawfully.
explanation.walkthrough: The name is tucked inside 'sea landed'; 'over the' and 'illegally' just dress the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: This common boy's name stands for any male person.

clue.text: Call in expert-may be finished

parts.note: to term something is to call it by a name
able means skilful, expert

explanation.surface: Bring in a specialist and the job could be over.
explanation.definitionFit: A contract that can be ended is one capable of being brought to a close.

clue.text: Very large loans, no answer when capital is needed

parts.note: OS is short for outsize, very large

indicators.note: no tells us the letters that follow are dropped

explanation.surface: Huge borrowings, unanswered, when funds are needed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like money in a sentence about loans, but it is a city: Norway's.
explanation.definitionFit: Norway's seat of government is a capital city.

clue.text: Concerned with showing proper appreciation

explanation.surface: Interested in being suitably grateful.
explanation.definitionFit: Regarding or about, and esteeming or honouring, are both senses of the word.
